Keep her identity, face, costume, colours, proportions, line style and the exact staff design from Image 1, at the same size and camera distance as Image 1, three-quarter view facing screen-right like Image 1.

Draw ONE single full-body sprite of her the instant a hard blow hits her from screen-right while she floats: her whole body is knocked back toward screen-left and tilted back about 15 degrees, head snapped back, a clear pained face with eyes squeezed shut, eyebrows knitted and teeth clenched (NOT smiling), her free left arm flung back behind her, her right hand still gripping the staff which is jolted outward and tilted back, her knees pulled up, her long hair, braids, hat tip and cape whipping forward toward screen-right from the jolt. A clear, readable silhouette that is obviously a hit reaction, not a pose of joy.

Background: 100% solid flat pure green #00FF00, no gradient, no floor, no shadow. Nothing on the character is green: keep the staff orb and every gem in the colours of Image 1. Centered, the whole character and staff fully inside the image with a wide green margin on all four sides. Clean anime game sprite, crisp lines, same rendering as Image 1. No glow, aura, lightning, sparks, impact star, particles, speed lines, sweat drops, text or labels.
